instruction: Extract the timestamp when the photograph was taken from the image pixels and convert it to Unix epoch time.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because timestamps cannot be extracted from image pixels themselves. While EXIF metadata might contain timestamp information, the task specifically asks to extract it 'from the image pixels', which is technically impossible. Pixel data contains color information, not temporal metadata.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - timestamps are stored in EXIF metadata, not in image pixels
The instruction specifically asks to extract timestamp 'from the image pixels', which is technically impossible since pixels only contain RGB/color data
